data.gender_notes: Fayina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘faino’, meaning ‘to rejoice’ or ‘to delight’. In the Bible, the name Fayina is not directly mentioned, but it shares a similar meaning with the Hebrew name ‘Rachael’, which means ‘euphonic’ or ‘joyful’. The name Fayina carries the meaning “Rejoicing, Delight” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fayina usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoicing, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes joy, happiness, and the celebration of life.
data.etymology: Fayina belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rejoicing, Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
